sections.title: LIVESTOCK
sections.reason: Major new gameplay feature introducing cows and sheep with genetics and breeding.

sections.title: Livestock economy
sections.reason: Details the economy around selling grown animals and trading wool for resources.

sections.title: Milk
sections.reason: Introduces milk, skimming for cream, and how they buff tea durations and potencies.

sections.title: livestock fencing
sections.reason: Minor deployables addition for the new livestock feature.

sections.title: Biofuel Generator
sections.reason: Adds a new way to use raw or spoiled meat to generate low grade fuel with manual stirring.

sections.title: Critters and Swimmers
sections.reason: Adds atmospheric small animals and swimmers mostly for set dressing.

sections.title: Air wolf repairable helipad
sections.reason: Major wipe meta change requiring communal effort to repair Bandit Camp helipads for air vehicles.

sections.title: sandbag stacking
sections.reason: Reworks sandbags into a 4-stage stackable system ending in a pillbox version.

sections.title: POWERGRID LOOT ROOMS
sections.reason: Adds new locked loot rooms across many monuments powered by Heavy Fuses.

sections.title: population decay scaling of Heavy fuses
sections.reason: Quality of life change scaling heavy fuse decay based on server population and moving a fuse box.

sections.title: Client Predicted Grenades/Explosives
sections.reason: Significantly improves combat feel for throwables and explosives on higher pings via client prediction.

sections.title: Machete refresh
sections.reason: Cosmetic and model update for the old machete.

sections.title: Country Selection UI Refresh
sections.reason: UI redesign for the server browser country selection.

sections.title: Performance - Viewmodel memory
sections.reason: Under-the-hood memory optimization removing duplicate hand meshes from viewmodels.

sections.title: New Workshop Skinnable: All Ladder Hatches
sections.reason: Workshop skinning support added for all types of ladder hatches.

sections.title: Plague Doctor Hazmat SUIT Item DLC
sections.reason: New cosmetic store item release.

sections.title: Performance - Dynamic Store Assets
sections.reason: Under-the-hood optimization for in-game store memory usage.

sections.title: Performance - Animation IK JObs
sections.reason: Technical performance improvement by multithreading inverse kinematics animations.

sections.title: Rust Render Pipeline
sections.reason: Major technical milestone migrating the game from Unity's old pipeline to a custom Rust Render Pipeline.

sections.title: Anticheat: Additional Secure Servers
sections.reason: Expands TPM and Secure Boot requirements to more official servers to combat cheaters.

sections.title: Crash uploading
sections.reason: Backend enhancement for automatic crash reporting.

sections.title: rust isles - Twitch Drops
sections.reason: Reminder for active Twitch drops and event.

sections.title: steam autumn sale
sections.reason: Steam Autumn Sale discounts for Rust and its DLCs.

sections.title: Halloween Update
sections.reason: Announcement date and time for the upcoming mandatory Halloween update.
